svg.title: Timeline: the proposed view
svg.desc: Opening the timeline turns the article editor's canvas read-only: it shows the article as it was at the chosen version, with what changed since the previous one marked. Under it, a rail holds a tick for every version, with marks for named, published and AI versions; dragging it, or the arrow keys, steps through them. On the right, the inspector's History tab lists the versions by day with their messages, and the chosen one offers Restore this version, Copy blocks and Name this version.

g.text: read only; what changed since the previous version is marked
Heading and paragraphs, drawn as the page draws them
A changed paragraph: removed words struck,
A figure, from that version's picture
drag, or arrow keys: one version a step; Page Up, a day

svg.text: The rail and the list are the same versions: choosing in one moves the other.
